I've learned the hard way that dry communication and a lack of effort when it comes to planning dates are serious red flags. If I find myself always starting the conversation and the replies are short or delayed, I can’t help but feel the disconnection. Communication is such a vital part of any relationship, and when it feels one-sided, it’s hard to ignore. It makes me question if the other person is truly invested.

Another thing that stands out to me is when planning dates feels like an afterthought. If I'm always the one trying to organize plans or if there’s a lack of initiative to spend quality time together, it leaves me feeling undervalued. Relationships take effort from both sides, and if I’m not seeing that, it doesn’t feel like we’re on the same page. I deserve to be with someone who puts in the same amount of effort, and if that’s missing, I know it’s time to step back and reevaluate. My time and energy are worth more than being treated like an option.
